availability: Free · LedgeKit API 0.23.0 · macOS 14 or later
description: Calculate in the notch with orange operator keys, a large result display and a full 10 × 5 scientific keypad. Type directly above the result and press Return, switch degrees and radians, use memory and inverse functions, pin the calculator open, or restore one of the last 50 calculations. Click the result to copy its full precision. Includes a compact result widget and an opening shortcut. Calculations stay on this Mac. Uses double-precision numbers, not arbitrary precision or currency conversion.
